section_sequence.what_it_does: Minimal white bar: logo left, 5 centered text links, language toggle + pill 'Download App' right; a vertical tick-mark progress indicator sits at the far left edge throughout.
Near-full-viewport rounded-corner lifestyle video card with a two-line centered white headline over its lower third; on scroll it cuts to a closer shot of the phone as the headline fades.
Rounded card of hands holding a phone with a transfer confirmation, caption and short copy at left.
Floating tilted phone right; left headline over a stacked list of features where one item at a time is solid with copy + CTA (e.g. 'Exchange with zero fees') and the rest are pale.
Centered headline + subline, then 3 gradient cards (loans, cards, insurance) with arrow buttons and captions.
Centered headline, then 3 dark media cards (AI earnings analysis, hands-off investing, community) with captions.
Full-bleed warm photo of a Toss parcel with 'Money doesn't stop at banking', followed by a product/rating shot ('Amo Italian' 5-star, 1,508).
Phone mockup of checkout (discount toggles, then 'Payment complete') left; stacked benefit statements right.
Grid-lined grey stage: 'From sale to payout, everything in one place' over a row of seller listing cards, then calendar card with 'paid within two days'.
'Different marketing objectives need different strategies' over 4 rounded ad-format cards (auto-play video ads, lucky quizzes, fullscreen ads, point missions).
'Turn 30 million Toss users into your customers' over a dotted terrain chart, then 'A trusted business partner' line with 'Advertise on Toss'.
Left copy + 'Learn more', right dashboard screenshot with a floating phone payment sheet ('Lower fees than cards'; mobile also shows 'Build checkout in 5 minutes').
'Beyond / boundaries' words flank a black shape that grows into a rounded card reading 'Built into everyday life. Now powering businesses.'
Dark desk scenes with a device center-right and small caption + 'Learn more' at lower-left, swapped per product (order kiosk, POS coupons, POS sales, Facepay).
'Everyday upgraded' + photo row, then a mosaic of rounded photo and widget tiles above 'When everything connects, life gets simpler'.
Dark navy section with a dotted globe and white multi-line manifesto ('A financial layer for everyday life...'); seen in mobile-scroll.jpg.
Present in outline (desktop y≈49062, mobile y=20326) but not reached by any image.

motion.observed: Hero card stays pinned for ~10 recorded seconds of wheel scrolling, then cuts to a closer side shot of the woman with the phone while the headline fades; outline puts the hero H2 at y=8294, i.e. a long pinned track.
t=0 frame of the recording is blank white with nav only; the photo card is present from 0.7s, and intro frames 0.7s to 8s show no change.
One feature line at a time turns solid with copy + CTA while the others stay pale; the phone screen and pop-out card change to match.

motion.where: headlines ('Finance without the homework', 'A trusted business partner')
motion.observed: Words go from blurred/pale grey to solid dark one at a time as scroll advances.
UI states advance within the mockup: checkout sheet to 'Payment complete'; Facepay screen 'Verifying your face' to 'Payment completed'.
Narrow black vertical pill between 'Beyond' and 'boundaries' widens into a large rounded card, pushing the words outward and revealing the statement.
Device and backdrop crossfade between kiosk, POS monitor and Facepay terminal while captions swap at lower-left.
Tiles and the closing headline start pale/washed out and resolve to full contrast.

reduced_motion: Hero looks identical to normal (same card, headline, progress ticks). capture.json running_animations = 0 in both modes; scroll-linked effects under reduced motion were not captured.
mobile: Nav becomes logo + hamburger and stays pinned. Hero card is taller than wide, cropped tight on the face, headline breaks into three lines. The pinned desktop scenes mostly become a plain vertical stack: the 'your money' features become separate card + caption + CTA blocks, and the finance and invest cards go single-column. Headline word reveals and the Beyond/boundaries card still appear. The page closes on a dark navy globe manifesto. The left progress ticks don't show at 393px.
adaptable_ideas: One idea per viewport: each scene holds a single product claim with one visual, advanced by scroll, so a very long page reads as a sequence of slides.
Scroll-scrubbed word reveal (pale/blurred to solid) for statement lines, reserving it for bridge sentences rather than every heading.
A thin vertical tick progress indicator at the page edge to orient users in a very long pinned narrative.
Shape-morph transition (pill expands to card, splitting a two-word phrase) as a chapter break between audiences (consumer to business).
